module: Spline manager of the editor's Decal Spline tool (prefix "Decal Spline", edit mode decalSplineEditMode): a decal spline follows a path (nodes, widths, normals) on which decals are distributed (spacing, jitter, rotation, atlas rows/columns, scale, frame, up to 4 components). The module keeps the list of splines and an id to index table, creates/deletes/splits/joins splines, handles undo/redo, profile copy, serialization (binary buffer or session JSON table), links with master splines, and rebuilds the geometry and decals of splines marked isDirty.
notes: A spline is a table: name, id (UUID), isDirty, isLoop, isLink/linkId, nodes (vec3), widths, nmls, divPoints/divWidths/tangents/binormals/normals/discMap (recomputed derived geometry), isEnabled, isAliasRoundRobin, roadLength, spacing, jitter, randomSeed, and per component n (1 to 4): rotN, numRowsN, numColsN, scaleN, frameN.
Slider default values: spacing 0, jitter 0, rot 1, randomSeed 41225, numRows 4, numCols 2, scale 1, frame 3, default material asphalt_patches; minimum 100 subdivisions; minimum path import size 10 m.

Any modification of a spline goes through isDirty = true: updateDirtyDecalSplines (called every frame by the tool) then rebuilds the geometry (catmullRomRaycast) and the decals (pop.populateDecalSpline). Fewer than 2 nodes: decals and derived geometry deleted.
A disabled spline (isEnabled = false) whose decals already exist is not rebuilt.

convertPathsToDecalSplines creates a spline for each path even if the path is too small (the spline then stays empty), and the log message counts #paths - #decalSplines (wrong if splines already existed).
deepCopyDecalSplineState is listed twice in the public interface (same function).

getDecalSplines.desc: Returns the splines table (reference, not copied).

getSplineMap.desc: Returns the spline id to index table.

setDecalSpline.desc: Places a spline at the given index and marks it isDirty.

setDecalSplines.desc: Places all splines of an array at the same indices (each marked isDirty); does not delete the others.

getDefaultSliderParams.desc: Returns the default slider values of the interface.

returns.desc: spacing, jitter, rot, randomSeed, numRows, numCols, scale, frame...

addNewDecalSpline.desc: Adds a new empty spline at the end with a unique name ("Decal Spline N"), an Engine.generateUUID() UUID and the default parameters.

splitDecalSpline.desc: Splits a spline at the given node into two splines. A loop is opened in place, starting at the chosen node.

joinDecalSplines.desc: Joins two non-looped splines: the concatenated geometry is applied to the first, the second is deleted. No effect if the node indices are invalid.

removeDecalSpline.desc: Deletes a spline, removes its decals from the scene, updates the index table, and deletes the decal folder if no spline remains.

removeLinkedDecalSpline.desc: Deletes a spline from its id (called when the master layer is deleted). No effect if the id is unknown.

removeAllDecalSplines.desc: Deletes the splines. With isIncludeDisabled true, all of them; otherwise only those enabled and not linked.

deepCopyDecalSpline.desc: Deep copy (string.buffer encode/decode) of a spline, with the derived geometry cleared.

deepCopyDecalSplineState.desc: Deep copy of all splines (for the undo history).

singleSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a single-spline edit with decalSplineData.old (if present).

singleSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes a single-spline edit with decalSplineData.new (if present).

transSplineEditUndo.desc: Undoes a global edit: deletes all splines, restores data.old, marks everything isDirty and recomputes the index table.

transSplineEditRedo.desc: Redoes a global edit with data.new.

copyDecalSplineProfile.desc: Copies the profile (decal distribution parameters) of a spline, without nodes, widths, nmls or derived geometry.

pasteDecalSplineProfile.desc: Applies a profile to a spline: deletes its decals, copies the parameters (spacing, jitter, rotN, numRowsN, numColsN, scaleN, frameN...) and marks it isDirty.

serializeDecalSpline.desc: Serializes a spline into a binary blob (string.buffer) for the editor.

serializeDecalSplineToTable.desc: Serializes a spline into a portable table for a session file: derived geometry cleared, scene handle removed, the live spline is not modified.

deserializeDecalSpline.desc: Deserializes a spline from the editor blob (string) or a session JSON table. On the JSON path, the derived tables are empty and the positions rehydrated as vec3 before the first build.

isCreateObject.desc: (inferred from code) indicates whether the object must be created

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id to index table (called by the session utility after a load).

updateDirtyDecalSplines.desc: Rebuilds the isDirty splines: vertical raycasts of the nodes, Catmull-Rom geometry, decals, length; marks the edit in the session if at least one was rebuilt. Called every frame by the tool.

convertPathsToDecalSplines.desc: Converts paths from an image (points in terrain grid) into splines: world coordinates via the terrain editor, terrain normals. Paths whose smallest dimension is at most 10 m are not imported (see notes).

getCurrentDecalSplineList.desc: List of enabled splines as {name, id, type} (type = tool prefix), for the selectors of other tools.

isLinked.desc: Indicates whether the spline with the given id is linked to a master spline.

setLink.desc: Enables or disables the link of a spline with a group, deletes its decals and marks it isDirty.

updateLinkedDecalSpline.desc: Updates a linked spline with the geometry of the master spline (nodes, widths, normals, loop). If fewer than 2 points, clears the derived geometry and deletes the decals.

unlinkAll.desc: Unlinks all linked splines and marks all splines isDirty.
